summary: Faulkner County lookout. Murphy's article describes a steel tower 'currently standing near Guy', erected in the early 1960s; no current source describes the site.

events.note: Murphy's article says a steel fire tower near Guy was erected in the early 1960s. The source gives only the decade, so 1960 stands for that decade and is not an exact date. Whether it is this lookout is not confirmed.

notes_for_editor: Thin. The only Guy-specific page (Central US Lookouts) gives the county and a township, range and section code and nothing else. The Murphy PDF is a scanned article with OCR-damaged columns; quotes are short so they can be matched. The steel tower Murphy calls 'currently standing near Guy' is probably this lookout, but no source ties the two. Murphy's footnote cites a web source checked on March 17, 2003, so the 'currently standing' phrasing is as of the article. No build year, agency, staffing, access or current status for the Guy lookout is in any source checked.
